name: Can't-rules of fired abilities — Burning-Tree Bloodscale's trait names the card; Coronation of Chaos lists creatures
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once targeted "can't block / can't be blocked / can't attack (or block)" units were audited (2026-11-17). Burning-Tree Bloodscale's "Target creature can't block this creature this turn" gave its target "Can't block Burning-Tree Bloodscale (activated)": _resolveTraitText read "this creature" as the fired ability's pseudo-permanent; it is now the card with the ability (CR 113.7). Coronation of Chaos ("Up to three target creatures can't block this turn. Goad them.") listed nothing: the goad effect took a restriction built from the word "them", which held for no permanent, and the multi-target picker uses the first restriction it finds.
